title: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
subtitle: Definitions, evidence-based management, safety, and when professional care matters for cognitive behavioral therapy.
evidence_strength: Strong evidence from systematic reviews and randomized controlled trials supports CBT efficacy for anxiety and depression, with moderate evidence for its effectiveness in other disorders. Some evidence indicates better relapse prevention with CBT compared to medication. Access and adherence factors limit outcomes in real-world settings.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
